column1: # The reviewed run spec (§2.7, round 17's AG2): each run's expectations, which the compare takes from here and never from
# a run's launch manifest. run <TAB> group <TAB> <process kind> <TAB> <n>: at least n processes of that kind with pairs.
# run <TAB> launch <TAB> <launch kind> <TAB> <n>: at least n launch rows of that kind (a gui row must also leave pairs).
# run <TAB> required <TAB> <function key> <TAB> <role>: a required pair (§2.7's table). run <TAB> advisory <TAB> <compiler>:
# on that compiler only the pair checks (PAIR-OUTSIDE-TABLE, MISSING-REQUIRED-PAIR) are reported and not gating; launch,
# dump, seal, malformed-input and unexpected-process failures still gate (r21, AJ3). A row may end with a compiler
# column (the --compiler value of the runs it applies to) and then applies only to those. r19 (round 18's AH2): a
# function key is the file and the bare symbol name, at 31796f5d0; round 18's L3: the soak's pairs; r20 (round 19's
# L8): those pairs are required on 0.17.1. 1B.3 removed the soak's advisory row for the 1A compiler (§19.2), with this
# spec's other mentions of it; the frozen copy in ci/fixture/ keeps both, which controls 83, 88 and 89 read.
# run <TAB> exits <TAB> required: require the supervisor's sealed process exits.
# run <TAB> exit <TAB> kind <TAB> unsigned code <TAB> yes|no: permit that abnormal outcome and layer marker.
